transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?

I'm really struggling because I've been eating massive amounts of food in one sitting, way more than a normal meal. Once I start, it feels like I completely lose control and just can't stop. It's getting really distressing and I don't know how to handle it anymore.
After these episodes, do you ever try to get rid of the food by vomiting, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?

Yes, I try to make up for it by completely fasting and not eating anything for a day or two afterward. I also force myself to exercise excessively, pushing way past my physical limits to try and burn it all off. I don't throw up or use laxatives, though.
How often do these binge episodes and compensatory behaviors happen, and has this been going on for at least 3 months?
Yes, both the binge eating and the fasting or extreme exercising happen at least once a week, on average. This has been going on consistently for about four months now.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Binge-Eating Disorder, Bulimia Nervosa], but binge eating disorder is now unlikely because the patient reports regular compensatory behaviors after binges (fasting and excessive exercise). This pattern is more consistent with bulimia nervosa, and the frequency/duration criteria are met.
